body:
Asha (PM): Quick follow-up after today's playtest: users miss context when SLO slider changes cost and pool suggestions flip. Need small fixes we can ship fast.

Drew (Design): Two tiny changes: 1) make slider label read "Target latency (ms)" and show a subtle hint "Lower = faster, higher cost". 2) in pool rows show a tiny 'Rec' badge (hover: 'Recommended to preserve SLO').

Liu (Eng): Backend: will add `recommended_reason` (short string) and `recommendation_age_s` to pool search. Also return `predicted_cost_delta_cents` on preview.

Rae (Frontend): I'll add an `aria-live="polite"` region that reads: 'Target latency 120 ms. Estimated throughput 45 QPS. Estimated cost $8/day.' Also ensure expanding capacity rows doesn't lose keyboard focus.

Jo (A11y): For the slider, set `aria-valuetext` to include units and context (e.g., '120 milliseconds, near recommended'). Badge tooltips must have accessible names and icon-only buttons need `aria-label`.

Asha (PM): Action items: Drew mock tweak + compact badge, Liu API fields, Rae live-region + focus fix, Jo a11y pass. Aim: small PRs by Tue. :thumbsup:
